data.name: Ocean Nourishment Corporation
data.description: Ocean Nourishment Corporation (ONC) is an Australian company incorporated in 2004 to develop Ocean Nourishment technology for marine carbon dioxide removal via macronutrient fertilization. Its PhytoPlus biostimulant is deployed from ships or offshore platforms to boost phytoplankton growth and drive long-duration carbon sequestration in deep water. ONC was a Top 100 Global Carbon Removal Innovator in the 2024 XPRIZE Carbon Removal Competition and is seeking partners in shipping and green hydrogen/ammonia.
